summary.en: Guarantee a pre-vote human reply, bind twelve authored characters, and add safe local connection registration and checking.
summary.zh: 保障投票前真人回应，绑定十二位预设人物，并增加安全的本机连接登记与检查。

reason: Explain the changed discussion flow, independent character/role selection, and actionable model onboarding.

compatibility.en: Adds one optional human reply before daytime exile voting. Existing table_answer actions are reused; old saves default to the legacy character mapping. Offline play remains uncounted.
compatibility.zh: 白天放逐投票前增加一次可选真人回应，复用 table_answer；旧存档保留原人物映射，离线仍不计成绩。
